Class GenericConfig

java.lang.Object
graph.GenericConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Config
public class GenericConfig extends Object implements Config
Reflection-based implementation of Config that builds the computational graph from a JSON configuration file.

Each entry in the config's "agents" array names an agent type plus its subs (input topics) and pubs (output topics). The class loads the matching agent class by name (defaulting to the graph.agents package), instantiates it through its (String[] subs, String[] pubs) constructor, and wraps every agent in a ParallelAgent so callbacks run off the publishing thread.

    • create

      public void create()
      Builds the agents and wires them to their topics.

      Reads the configured JSON file, instantiates every declared agent via reflection, and wraps each one in a ParallelAgent. Does nothing if no config file was set.

      Specified by:
      create in interface Config
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the file cannot be parsed, the "agents" array is missing, an entry lacks a "type", or an agent cannot be instantiated

    • close

      public void close()
      Tears down the agents created by Config.create(), releasing their resources.

      Closes every agent created by create() (unsubscribing them from their topics) and forgets them, so the configuration can be rebuilt cleanly.
